idRule: Hexagram id = six-character binary string, top line (上爻, bit 5) on the left, bottom line (初爻, bit 0) on the right; yin 0, yang 1. Leading zeros are kept. The id is fixed and separate from the King Wen number.
paths: Paths are relative to this file. Each entry names the exact file version the app shows. To update content, save a new dated file and a new index that points to it; old files stay as they are.
